---
title: "3D fold-up"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-fold3d
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
library(DT)
gaps <- stat_table("glue-gaps")
glue_status <- stat_table("glue-status")
render <- file.path(STATS, paste0(PROJECT, "-3d.png"))
# The per-edge glue table is only in a local build (`make preview`), never on the public site.
glue <- if (file.exists("generated/3d-glue.csv")) read_csv("generated/3d-glue.csv", col_types = cols(number = col_character()))
```

The fold-up prototype (`make -f fold3d.mk`) folds the traced pieces along their score lines and
glues them edge to edge, the way the paper model is built. Each glued edge gets the gap left
between the two sides in the folded model. A small gap means the traced outlines, folds and
edge numbers agree in 3D, not only on the sheet.

```{r}
#| label: fold3d-summary
#| output: asis
if (is.na(stat("glue_total"))) {
  cat("No fold-up statistics are committed yet (`make -f fold3d.mk`, then `make report-data`).\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("%d glued edges: %d close (median gap %.1f mm).\n",
              stat("glue_total"), stat("glue_closes"), stat("glue_median_gap_mm")))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fold3d-render
#| output: asis
if (file.exists(render)) cat(sprintf("![The folded trace, rendered by the fold-up.](%s){width=70%%}\n", render))
```

```{r}
#| label: fold3d-gaps
#| fig-cap: "Gap between the two sides of each glued edge in the folded model (log scale)."
if (!is.null(gaps)) {
  gaps |>
    mutate(status = fct_reorder(status, n, sum, .desc = TRUE)) |>
    ggplot(aes(10^(gap_bin + 0.1), n, fill = status)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.18, position = "stack", orientation = "x") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(closes = HI[["blue"]], `proposed, closes` = HI[["teal"]],
                                 `does not close` = HI[["orange"]], `let go while building` = HI[["red"]],
                                 `proposed by shape only, not glued` = HI[["yellow"]])) +
    labs(x = "gap (mm)", y = "glued edges", fill = NULL) +
    theme_hi() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-glue-status
#| tbl-cap: "Glued edges by outcome."
if (!is.null(glue_status)) {
  glue_status |> arrange(desc(n)) |> rename(Outcome = status, Edges = n) |> knitr::kable()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fold3d-local
#| output: asis
if (!is.null(glue)) cat("## Edges that do not close\n\nLocal build only.\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: fold3d-table
#| column: page-right
if (!is.null(glue)) {
  glue |>
    filter(status != "closes") |>
    arrange(desc(gap_mm)) |>
    mutate(status = factor(status)) |>
    datatable(
      rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", class = "compact stripe",
      colnames = c("Number", "Piece", "Tab piece", "Length", "Length diff", "Gap", "Look-alike", "Status"),
      options = list(pageLength = 25)
    )
}
```
